email_body:
Dear GIMBER team,

I'm excited to apply for the All-round Marketing Intern position. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content creation, and social media, I'm drawn to GIMBER's bold mission and vibrant brand. I'm eager to contribute to your community building and campaign execution.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites. On my own project, mirook.com, I've implemented structured data and social media integration, and I've tracked performance using analytics tools. I'm comfortable with data, creative, and proactive—I love spotting trends and taking initiative.

I'm available for a minimum of 3 months, speak English fluently, and am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp. I'm also improving my Dutch (B1). I'm excited about the opportunity to support your social media, influencer, and trade marketing activities.

I'd love to bring my energy and skills to the G-Tribe. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear GIMBER team,

When I read that GIMBER is for those who live life to the fullest—pure, powerful, and unapologetically bold—I felt an immediate connection. As a junior digital marketer with a technical edge and a creative spark, I'm excited to apply for the All-round Marketing Intern role. I'm drawn to your mission of bringing people together with bold, sustainable products, and I'm ready to fuel the fire.

Currently, as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and I write keyword-targeted blog content that grows organic traffic. I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and I track performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console. This hands-on experience has made me comfortable with data, creative, and analytical—exactly the combination you're looking for.

On my own project, mirook.com, I've designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and social media integration. I've run iterative SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project has honed my ability to work independently, take initiative, and see projects through from concept to execution.

I'm naturally curious and love spotting trends, especially in social media and creator culture. I'm a strong communicator who enjoys collaborating across teams and partners. I'm available for a minimum of 3 months, speak English fluently, and am based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp. I'm also improving my Dutch (B1).

I'm eager to contribute to your social media, influencer, and campaign initiatives, and to grow with a team that champions people, dares to own it, and shakes things up. Thank you for considering my application.

Warm regards,

Baver Ok
